nodes.label: Engine.ServeHTTP
nodes.desc: routeTreesUpdated.Do once, pool.Get, reset, handleHTTPRequest, pool.Put

nodes.label: Engine.pool (sync.Pool)
nodes.desc: Pool of *Context objects; pool.New calls allocateContext(maxParams)

nodes.label: allocateContext
nodes.desc: Preallocates Params and skippedNodes slices to engine.maxParams/maxSections

nodes.label: Context.reset
nodes.desc: Clears handlers, index=-1, Keys, Errors, query/form caches before reuse

nodes.label: handleHTTPRequest
nodes.desc: Resolves rPath (EscapedPath/RawPath variants), scans trees for the method

nodes.label: methodTrees
nodes.desc: Slice of methodTree{method, root}; get() does a linear scan

nodes.label: methodTrees.get
nodes.desc: Returns the radix root for one HTTP method or nil

nodes.label: Engine.addRoute
nodes.desc: Creates a root node per method, tracks maxParams/maxSections

nodes.label: node.addRoute
nodes.desc: Radix insert: split edges on longest common prefix, merge wildcards, panic on conflicts

nodes.label: node.insertChild
nodes.desc: Creates the terminal node, validates :param and *catchAll segments

nodes.label: node.incrementChildPrio
nodes.desc: Bumps child priority and reorders children plus indices string

nodes.label: node.getValue
nodes.desc: Iterative walk: match indices bytes, handle :param/*catchAll, set tsr flag

nodes.label: skippedNode stack
nodes.desc: Backtracking frames recorded before descending into wildcards

nodes.label: HandlersChain
nodes.desc: []HandlerFunc; Last() is the final handler

nodes.label: RouterGroup.combineHandlers
nodes.desc: Copies group.Handlers then route handlers; asserts total < abortIndex

nodes.label: RouterGroup.handle
nodes.desc: Joins base path, combines handlers, calls engine.addRoute

nodes.label: Context.Next
nodes.desc: index++ loop invoking each pending handler; re-entrant from middleware

nodes.label: abortIndex = math.MaxInt8>>1
nodes.desc: Sentinel int8 value (63) that marks the chain as aborted

nodes.label: Context.Abort
nodes.desc: Sets index to abortIndex; current handler still runs to completion

nodes.label: Context.AbortWithStatus
nodes.desc: Status + WriteHeaderNow + Abort for auth-style rejections

nodes.label: Context.ShouldBind
nodes.desc: binding.Default(method, ContentType) then ShouldBindWith

nodes.label: Context.ShouldBindJSON
nodes.desc: Shortcut for ShouldBindWith(obj, binding.JSON)

nodes.label: binding.Default
nodes.desc: GET always Form; body MIME types map JSON/XML/ProtoBuf/MsgPack/YAML/TOML/BSON

nodes.label: jsonBinding.Bind
nodes.desc: Validates req.Body then hands it to decodeJSON

nodes.label: decodeJSON
nodes.desc: Codec-aware decoder (sonic/go-json/jsoniter) then validate(obj)

nodes.label: binding.validate
nodes.desc: Delegates to the package-level Validator; nil validator skips

nodes.label: defaultValidator
nodes.desc: Wraps go-playground/validator/v10, lazily initialized via sync.Once

nodes.label: ValidateStruct
nodes.desc: Reflects over structs and slice/array elements; tag name is 'binding'

nodes.label: Context.JSON
nodes.desc: c.Render(code, render.JSON{Data: obj})

nodes.label: render.JSON
nodes.desc: Sets Content-Type application/json and writes encoded body

nodes.label: responseWriter.WriteHeaderNow
nodes.desc: Commits status 200 lazily; ServeHTTP calls it after the chain returns

nodes.label: Recovery middleware
nodes.desc: RecoveryWithWriter(DefaultErrorWriter); broken-pipe aware

nodes.label: serveError
nodes.desc: Runs the 404/405 chain, writes default body if nothing rendered

nodes.label: redirectTrailingSlash
nodes.desc: 301 for GET / 307 otherwise when only the trailing slash differs

edges.label: linear scan over one tree per method
push a frame before wildcard descent
append methodTree{method, root} on first route
